themes.headline: Headline
themes.more_than_one: You are more than one thing

slogans.text: You're a beautiful person, not a *profitable product*.
slogans.es: Eres una persona hermosa, no un *producto rentable*.

slogans.text: *Grinding* is better than Grindr.
slogans.es: *Perrear* es mejor que Grindr.

slogans.text: *IRL* is better than ASL.
Swipe less. *Sweat more.*
slogans.es: Desliza menos. *Suda más.*

slogans.text: Screen time is not *face time*.
slogans.es: Tiempo en pantalla no es *tiempo cara a cara*.

slogans.text: *Engagement* is when you leave the app.
slogans.es: El verdadero *engagement* es salir de la app.

slogans.text: *Conversation:* the original hookup app.
slogans.es: *Platicar:* la app de ligue original.

slogans.text: Just because they're your type doesn't mean they're *your match*.
slogans.es: Que sea tu tipo no significa que sea *tu match*.

slogans.text: Getting out is better than *getting off*.
Pervy or pious? *There's a night for that.*
slogans.es: ¿Perverso o piadoso? *Hay una noche para eso.*

slogans.text: Bear. Bookworm. Ballet fan. *Yes, all at once.*
slogans.es: Oso. Ratón de biblioteca. Fan del ballet. *Sí, todo a la vez.*

slogans.text: Don't show up in drag on Leather Night. *Find Leather Drag Night.*
slogans.es: No llegues en drag a la Noche de Cuero. *Busca la Noche de Drag en Cuero.*

slogans.text: Oh, *Leather Night* is next Thursday.
slogans.es: Ay, la *Noche de Cuero* es el próximo jueves.

slogans.text: Bring a *harness* or bring a *hymnal*, just know which night it is.
Is this the night for a *harness* or a *hymnal?*
slogans.es: ¿Esta noche toca *arnés* o *himnario?*

slogans.text: Friends for a reason, or friends for a season. *At least a Drag Race season.*
You are a beautiful, complete person. *Bring all of you to tonight.*
slogans.es: Eres una persona hermosa y completa. *Esta noche, trae todo lo que eres.*

slogans.text: We're not mining you. *We're meeting you.*
*Broke and fabulous* are not opposites.
slogans.es: *Sin lana y con glamour* no son opuestos.

slogans.text: Sober is a *vibe*, not a verdict.
slogans.es: La sobriedad es una *vibra*, no un veredicto.

slogans.text: Tags *open doors*. They never close them.
slogans.es: Las etiquetas *abren puertas*. Nunca las cierran.

slogans.text: Say hi. *Worst case, you've said hi.*
slogans.es: Saluda. *En el peor de los casos, saludaste.*

slogans.text: Make friends. *Maybe even ask their name.*
slogans.es: Haz amistades. *Hasta pregúntale su nombre.*

slogans.text: Latin night, for those who can *roll their Rs.*
slogans.es: Noche latina, para quien sabe *hacer vibrar la erre.*
notes: Tongue joke, kept to the R

slogans.text: If being Latin and gorgeous is a crime, *lock us up.*
slogans.es: Si ser latino y guapo es delito, *que nos lleven presos.*
notes: Spanish could say "latine" if the venue prefers

slogans.text: Does he have an *ESP button?*
slogans.es: ¿Y ese también *habla los dos idiomas?*
notes: Bilingual and bi: the phone menu’s “press 2 for Español”

slogans.text: Bilingual. *Bisexual.* Always happy to practice.
slogans.es: Bilingüe. *Bisexual.* Siempre con ganas de practicar.

slogans.text: Bi night, fluent in both. *Noche bi, se me dan los dos.*
slogans.es: Bi night, fluent in both. *Noche bi, se me dan los dos.*
notes: Prints both languages on every poster: bilingual and bi

slogans.text: Hard shell or soft? *¿Por qué no los dos?*
slogans.es: ¿Taco duro o suave? *¿Por qué no los dos?*
notes: The taco ad meme; the punchline stays in Spanish on both

slogans.text: Why pick a side? *¿Por qué no los dos?*
slogans.es: ¿Escoger un lado? *¿Por qué no los dos?*

slogans.text: Spanglish spoken here. *Flirting too.*
slogans.es: Aquí se habla Spanglish. *Y también se coquetea.*

slogans.text: Two languages. *One dance floor.*
slogans.es: Dos idiomas. *Una sola pista.*

slogans.text: *Cheeky* in every sense.
A little *cheek* goes a long way.
Turn the other cheek. *Then shake it.*
Come for the cheek kisses. *Stay for the cheeks.*
My brothers, in… *Christ!*
Be cheeky. Get a kiss on the cheek. *Maybe grab a cheek.*
